name: sd_and_display
description: The two buses that carry a game: SD over SPI and the 8080 panel

assert.name: the SD bus lands on the socket's own pad roles
no SD socket pad shares a net with a strapping pin
assert.because: Was pinned at 1 through v4.5.0: U6.9 sat on BTN_R = GPIO3, held to be inert because table 8 leaves GPIO3 ignored at default eFuses. R31-HIGH-2 found the error under that analysis — pad 9 is the socket's card-detect spring, not DAT2, so it is a switch to the grounded shell rather than an idle card contact, and no eFuse argument applies to it. The BTN_R riser was rerouted east of the pad row and the pad is off-net. Pinned at exactly 0 so the exposure returning fails here.

assert.name: the data bus arrives in order
assert.because: crossing two data lines is invisible to every pad-side gate

assert.name: the panel's unused pins all obey the datasheet
assert.because: R28-HIGH-1 FIXED 2026-07-26: J4 pad 28 (panel pin 13, SPI SDI) now stubs to pad 29's +3V3 per the pin table's 'fix at VDDI or DGND'. Pinned at exactly 0 so any NEW disobedient pin fails this scenario; the old float is preserved as a detach_pin mutation entry (T5.1) so the bench must still rediscover it. Boards fabricated before the fix have pin 13 floating — as-built note in docs/known-issues.md.
